reasoning: On the season so far the Nuggets are the stronger team; with home court the Nuggets start about 11 points better, in a game of about 243 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 2 points towards the Bulls.
No psychological spot stands out for either team.
Bottom line: the Nuggets win 75 times in 100, by about 9; most games like this end between 217 and 266 total points.
